signature.name: VTask.centerMass
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {E : Type u_3} -> {ι : Type u_5} -> [Field R] -> [AddCommGroup E] -> [Module R E] -> (t : Finset ι) -> (w : ι → R) -> (z : ι → E) -> E

conventions.statement: When `∑ i ∈ t, w i = 0`, the field reciprocal of 0 is 0, so `VTask.centerMass t w z = 0` (the zero vector of E).
conventions.note: This follows from the junk-value convention `(0 : R)⁻¹ = 0` in any `Field`.

conventions.statement: When `t = ∅`, both the weighted sum and total weight are 0, so `VTask.centerMass ∅ w z = 0`.
conventions.note: Special case of the zero-total-weight convention; holds for all w and z.

facts.statement: ∀ (t : Finset (Fin 3)) (w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (z : Fin 3 → ℚ) (c : ℚ), c ≠ 0 → VTask.centerMass t (fun i => c * w i) z = VTask.centerMass t w z

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (a b : ℚ) (wa wb : ℚ), wa + wb ≠ 0 → VTask.centerMass ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) (fun i => if i = 0 then wa else wb) (fun i => if i = 0 then a else b) = (wa + wb)⁻¹ * (wa * a + wb * b)
